title: system.processes
description: Returns a snapshot of running processes via macOS `ps -axwwo pid,ucomm,%cpu,%mem,etime`. Each record reports PID, user command name (ucomm — kernel's exec name, capped at ~15 chars on macOS), CPU percent, memory percent, and elapsed runtime. Caller may optionally pass `limit` (integer 1-200, default 50) and `sort_by` ('cpu' | 'memory' | 'pid', default 'cpu'). Returns available: false if the ps command fails. No authentication required. Cached for 5 seconds.

limit.description: Maximum number of process records to return after sorting.

sort_by.description: Sort key. 'cpu' and 'memory' are descending; 'pid' is ascending.
